verdict.rationale: SumUp documents Virtual Solo, a simulated reader that works with a sandbox merchant account to test the Cloud API pairing and checkout flow before switching to a physical reader. It also documents preparing a merchant account, device and integration for testing. Sandbox accounts and test cards are documented, but on the online-payments testing page rather than the in-person one. missing for 10: simulated-reader or test-card coverage for the Reader SDK, Tap to Pay and Payment Switch paths; in-person test scenarios such as declines and failures; independent or hands-on corroboration.
